hero.title: Pay for a service or send any amount
hero.lead: Choose a package or enter an amount, then pay with UPI, card or PayPal. You'll see who you're paying before you confirm.

custom.title: Pay a custom amount
custom.text: For invoices, deposits or anything else agreed with me.
custom.notePlaceholder: What is this payment for? (e.g. invoice number)

items.title: Choose
items.text: Pick a package or enter an amount.

items.title: Pay
items.text: Use UPI, a card or PayPal. Check the payee name before you confirm.

items.title: Share the reference
items.text: Send me the payment reference so I can match it to your order.

after.title: After you pay
after.text: Send the transaction reference or a screenshot so I can confirm your payment.

items.title: Refund policy
items.text: Refunds are handled case by case. Contact me within 7 days of payment.

items.title: Terms
items.text: Payments are for services agreed in advance. Prices include applicable taxes unless stated.

footer.text: Payments are processed by UPI apps, Razorpay, Stripe or PayPal. This page never sees your card or bank details.
